name: How often should I repaint my house exterior?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint my house exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of exterior repainting depends on various factors such as the quality of the previous paint job, the type of paint used, local weather conditions, and the materials your home is constructed from. Generally, most homes in our service areas like Irvine or Newport Beach benefit from repainting every 5-10 years. Homes exposed to harsh sun or coastal elements may require more frequent attention, while those with high-quality paint and minimal exposure might last longer. Regular inspections can help determine the optimal time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repaint every 5-10 years, depending on paint quality, weather exposure, and materials. Coastal homes or those in harsh sun may need more frequent repainting.
